m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Baby Dragonfly? Where would a Spellbinder like you get one of those? Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmm?
Oh well, they are beautiful and feisty.
But you must keep them well fed! Or they get cranky. And will bite your fingers off. Hah!
But since you asked, baby Dragonflies love Mosquito Larvae. You can find some in the Chiroptera Cave. That's where we harvest it.
<ITALICS>He could have warned you about the bats! </ITALICS>
Ah, Mosquito Larvae! Of course. The baby looks hungry!
Er... it's a bit... squicky. I know you Spellbinders are made of stern stuff. Would you mind, er... hand-feeding her?
<ITALICS>You carefully hold the Mosquito Larvae out to the baby Dragonfly. She gobbles it down and asks for more. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Once you finish feeding the Dragonfly, she makes a contented hurrrrming sound at you. </ITALICS>
Look, the baby Dragonfly has hatched! She's cute, after her fashion. But she's ravenous! I have no idea what to feed her.
Maybe you can ask the Hundred Legger that helped you last time, Z'ur Grush? Quickly, before she nips my fingers off!
Ask Z'ur Grush what baby Dragonflies eat, and try to get some food quickly!
